selection_rule: One finalized completed and independently scored output per fixed query. Where multiple completed scored outputs exist, use the latest completed output, not the highest score.
execution_policy: Infrastructure and execution interruptions are recorded separately. Observed service errors/waits below describe the artifacts; they do not establish that an error caused an incorrect answer.
attempt_field: Number of retained researcher trial paths per query at export; not extra accuracy observations.
resource_scope: Published time and token summaries cover only the selected outputs. Other execution artifacts and judging usage are not added to those means.
historical_manifest_note: Commitment to the private path-bearing source manifest. This public projection uses artifact hashes instead of machine paths.
ungraded_history: Null correctness means no valid saved judgment was available; it is not an incorrect grade.
additional_execution_trigger: Manual decisions: recovery of noncompleted attempts; a targeted review of already-graded incorrect BCP outputs with substantial local quota waits; and further recovery following service or transport interruptions. Grades were visible, and correctness was used to identify the BCP review subset. This was not a uniformly applied outcome-blind retry policy.
single_artifact_trigger_count_note: Not defined: no single predeclared event threshold was applied to all 423 questions. The event counts describe saved artifacts and do not establish that service faults caused incorrect answers.
